title: 第17章 第一次受罚第18章 你们都要申灵草是几个意思
slug: 我只想毁灭宗门咋逆天成神了
lines: 采购出错的事情如风一般传遍整个灵鹤宫，灵鹤宫上下无论是普通弟子还是精英弟子，乃至于核心弟子都闻讯赶来。
每一个赶来的人都是二话不说跪在地上为楚星河求情。
这一幕看的魏德谦是头皮发麻。
他很难想象，一个人到底如何才能够让整个灵鹤宫出来为他求情。
不止魏德谦，大长老一样震惊。
可是震惊之余他更多的是高兴。
大长老知道楚星河在灵鹤宫人缘极好，之前师兄们为了他的灵冢之行那可是费尽心思啊。
可是大长老看到今天这一幕才知道，自己终究还是小看了楚星河。
所谓共富贵容易，共患难难。
今日如果是楚星河受到奖励，所有人都来恭喜他那么大长老不会觉得有丝毫问题。
可是楚星河今天犯了大错，自己如此震怒之下，这群孩子应该知道自己的脾气，以前也有帮忙求情的，自己对于求情者那都是一并处罚的。
“你们都站起来！
再有敢求情者一并处罚！”
大长老厉声喝道。
可是这一刻，没有一个人站起来，所有人都跪在原地一动不动。
这一幕真的让大长老震撼了……但他心中更多的是欣慰。
刚才他喊出那句话其实就是想看看，面对自己的处罚，这些人到底是会因为害怕处罚转身就走，还是真的不顾一切维护他们的星河师弟。
现在大长老有答案了。
楚星河这小子……
从昊天宗建立以来，从有了灵鹤宫开始，还从未有过一个人能够有如此魅力，短短时间让整个灵鹤宫上下为他甘愿受罚！
可是仔细想想，大长老明白，楚星河没有做什么……他只是做好了他自己，对每一个师兄都无比谦卑，什么苦活累活全都抢着去做。
从精英弟子到核心弟子，再到自己的亲传弟子，甚至差点成为宗主的亲传弟子，如果换成他人，那还不得傲世九重天？
可楚星河没有，他依旧还是那个别人眼中的绝世好师弟，对于师兄他从来不会因为自己的身份而有任何变化，哪怕是一个最普通的灵鹤宫弟子，楚星河见到也是恭恭敬敬的行礼喊一声师兄早啊。
不管是谁，找到楚星河帮忙，从来都是有求必应，别人不愿意做的，他去做，别人觉得累的，他不怕累。
这样的楚星河无形之中已经影响了整个灵鹤宫，而且不管灵鹤宫谁犯了错，别人不敢求情，楚星河敢。
哪怕自己最生气的时候曾说过再敢求情就让他滚出昊天宗。
可大长老依旧记得当时楚星河那坚定的眼神以及话语。
“大长老，倘若将我逐出宗门能够让您消气，那么请大长老将我逐出宗门，师兄虽然有错，但无心之失不该受到如此责罚，大长老要惩罚就惩罚我吧！
请放过我师兄！”
这是楚星河的话，从楚星河进灵鹤宫以来，只要有师兄犯错的地方，就有楚星河求情求代替师兄受罚的场面。
一次……两次……每一次……
大长老记不清有多少次了，但大长老知道在灵鹤宫，星河师弟是每一个人都每天挂在嘴边的，哪怕是私底下他也从未听人说过楚星河的坏话。
灵鹤宫的长老也从四面八方赶来，看到现场的一幕也是一个个满脸震惊。
可是很快长老们也开口了：“大长老，人无完人，星河这孩子的秉性你最了解，此次他的确是第一次经手此事，犯错也是难免，莫说星河这孩子，便是你我年轻之时又何尝没有犯过错呢。”
content_en:
The news about the procurement error spread throughout the Linghe Palace like the wind. Everyone from the ordinary disciples to the elite disciples and even the core disciples of the Linghe Palace came to hear the news.
Everyone who came over knelt on the ground to plead for Chu Xinghe without saying a word.
Watching this scene, Wei Deqian's scalp went numb.
It was hard for him to imagine how one person could get the entire Linghe Palace to come out to plead for him.
Not only Wei Deqian, but also the great elder was shocked.
But apart from being shocked, he was even more happy.
The First Elder knew that Chu Xinghe was very popular in Linghe Palace, and the senior brothers had previously put a lot of effort into his trip to the spiritual tomb.
But it was only when the Great Elder saw today's scene that he realized that he had underestimated Chu Xinghe after all.
It is said that it is easy to share wealth and honor, but it is easy to share hardships.
If Chu Xinghe received a reward today and everyone came to congratulate him, then the elder would not think there was any problem.
But Chu Xinghe made a big mistake today. When he was so angry, these children should know his temper. Some of them had helped to plead for mercy in the past, and he punished all those who pleaded for mercy.
"You all stand up!
Anyone who dares to plead for mercy will also be punished! "
The great elder shouted sharply.
But at this moment, no one stood up, and everyone knelt there motionless.
This scene really shocked the great elder...but he was more relieved in his heart.
The reason he shouted those words just now was because he wanted to see whether these people would turn around and leave because they were afraid of being punished, or whether they would really protect their Junior Brother Xinghe at all costs.
Now the great elder has the answer.
This kid Chu Xinghe...
Ever since the establishment of the Haotian Sect and the establishment of the Linghe Palace, there has never been a person with such charm who made the entire Linghe Palace willing to be punished for him in such a short period of time!
But thinking about it carefully, the First Elder understood that Chu Xinghe didn't do anything... he just did his best, was extremely humble to every senior fellow apprentice, and rushed to do all the hard work.
From an elite disciple to a core disciple, then to his own direct disciple, and even almost becoming the sect master's direct disciple. If it were someone else, would he still be proud of the ninth level?
But Chu Xinghe didn't. He was still the peerless good junior brother in the eyes of others. He would never change anything about his senior brother because of his identity. Even if he was the most ordinary disciple of Linghe Palace, when Chu Xinghe saw him, he would respectfully salute and call him "good morning, senior brother."
No matter who asked Chu Xinghe for help, he would always respond to requests. He would do what others were unwilling to do, and he would not be afraid of getting tired if others found it tiring.
Such Chu Xinghe has invisibly affected the entire Linghe Palace, and no matter who in Linghe Palace made a mistake, others would not dare to plead for mercy, but Chu Xinghe would.
Even when he was the most angry, he said that if he dared to plead for mercy again, he would get out of the Haotian Sect.
But the Great Elder still remembered Chu Xinghe’s firm eyes and words at that time.
"Great Elder, if expelling me from the sect can make you feel better, then please, Great Elder, expel me from the sect. Although my senior brother is at fault, he should not be punished for his unintentional mistake. If the Great Elder wants to punish me, then punish me!
Please let my brother go! "
These were Chu Xinghe's words. Ever since Chu Xinghe entered Linghe Palace, whenever his senior brother made a mistake, there would be a scene where Chu Xinghe would beg for mercy and be punished on his behalf.
Once...twice...every time...
The First Elder couldn't remember how many times, but the First Elder knew that in Linghe Palace, Junior Brother Xinghe was talked about by everyone every day. Even in private, he had never heard anyone say anything bad about Chu Xinghe.
The elders of Linghe Palace also came from all directions, and they were all shocked when they saw the scene.
But soon the elders also spoke: "First Elder, no one is perfect. You know the character of the child Xinghe best. This is indeed the first time he has dealt with this matter. It is inevitable to make mistakes. Not to mention the child Xinghe, even you and I didn't make mistakes when we were young."
